name: Precedent Maker
original_name: プレスデントメイカー
source:
It Begins...
"My name is TigerToe GentleJustice.
I'm 16 years old, a senior at Wellvalley School.
I'm training hard to become a Knight.

"Though I'm young, it's a time of war.
I have a fiancee and everything.

"It's possible to become a Summoner.
I want to be a Knight, but a Summoner is cool.

"This is my story."

* A digital novel set of medieval European style.
A world of magic and warriors and avarice.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE073357.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事开始……

“我叫虎趾·正义绅士。
我16岁，就读于威尔谷学校高年级。
我正努力训练，想成为一名骑士。

“虽然我还年轻，但正值战争时期。
我连未婚妻都有了。

“我也有可能成为召唤师。
我想成为骑士，但召唤师也很酷。

“这是我的故事。”

* 一套中世纪欧洲风格背景的电子小说。
一个充满魔法、战士与贪婪的世界。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE073357.html]DLsite English[/url]]
